overviewParagraphs: The Lake Course at Sky Lake Resort Golf Club is the public-facing companion to the exclusive Sky Course, and it is no consolation prize. Framed by dramatic limestone karst formations that rise from the landscape like natural amphitheatre walls, the setting is among the most visually spectacular of any course in Northern Vietnam.

Designed by Korean architect Ahn Moon Hwan (Bori Golf Design), the Lake Course plays 6,987 yards from the Blue Tees, with generous fairways giving way to well-guarded paspalum green complexes and natural lake hazards that demand precision.

Open to all players, the Lake Course is an excellent option for golfers of any ability visiting Hanoi, offering world-class scenery paired with a fair yet engaging test of golf. A firm favourite with AGS groups and returning international golf groups who have done the Hanoi circuit before.

curatorBriefHtml: Sky Lake’s Lake Course (opened 2012, designed by Ahn Moon Hwan) is Hanoi’s premier private tournament test — consistently ranked among Vietnam’s toughest championship 18-hole layouts. Measuring 6,987 yards from the Blue Tees (stretching past 7,550 yards from the tips, Par 72), the routing hugs the shoreline of Van Son Lake with sweeping limestone peaks towering overhead and water guarding landing zones and greens across both nines.

Unlike the more accessible visitor-friendly Sky Course next door, the Lake Course operates primarily as a members-and-invited-guests loop, preserving brisk pace of play and pristine, slick Paspalum greens. Wayward drives find water or penal rough fast — making disciplined iron play and accurate caddie reads essential.
AGS arranges curated weekday and priority visitor tee times on the Lake Course for guests staying in Hanoi, often pairing it with the sister Sky Course or Thanh Lanh Valley.

scorecard.verdict: The Lake Course is universally respected as one of the sternest championship tests in Vietnam. Stretching to 6,987 yards from the Blue Tees with water guarding nearly every target, it demands disciplined long-iron play and course management.

faqs.q: Can visiting golfers play the private Lake Course at Sky Lake?
faqs.a: Yes, with advance coordination. While the Lake Course is primarily reserved for club members and invited guests (especially on weekends), Asia Golf Specialists secures curated weekday visitor allocations as part of custom Hanoi golf packages.

faqs.q: What makes Sky Lake's Lake Course harder than the Sky Course?
faqs.a: The Lake Course weaves tightly along Van Son Lake with frequent water carries, narrower fairway landing zones, and firmer, faster green complexes — rewarding precision over brute power.

faqs.q: How far is Sky Lake Lake Course from central Hanoi?
faqs.a: Roughly 50 to 65 minutes southwest of central Hanoi (Hoan Kiem District) by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: What is the prime season to play Sky Lake Lake Course?
faqs.a: October through April brings crisp 18–26°C temperatures, minimal rainfall, and tournament-speed Paspalum putting surfaces.
